messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we have three enterprise compliance asks that keep coming up: extended audit retention, BYOK escrow + attestation, and SOC2/ISO evidence export. Need to prioritize for H2 roadmap and pick beta slots. My rough proposal below.

Julian: Can we get a quick cost delta for 24mo retention vs current 90d? storage + index + query perf?

Priya: Did a back-of-envelope: ~100TB baseline tenant set => hot index for 90d ~30TB. Extending to 24mo if fully indexed => hot+warm ~110TB, so infra delta ~+18% if we keep warm searchable; if we cold-tier and only keep compressed archives searchable on-demand it's ~+5%. Will share spreadsheet.

Priya: ```retention sketch:
- current: 90d hot index
- option A: tiered (90d hot, 21mo cold archive) => +5% cost, restore path ~hours
- option B: full-warm 24mo index => +18% cost, queries sub-300ms SLO harder
```

Sam: Ops/Infra: Tiered approach seems most practical. We'll need: runtime flags for opt-in tenants, an async restore job for cold -> warm, and index compaction to keep search latency stable. Also this touches SLA wording.

LegalBot: Legal: BYOK escrow/attestation requires explicit contract language and key-recovery opt-in. We need customer-signed SLAs and KMS attestation docs. Draft ETA 2 weeks to get a standard clause.

Maya: Proposed decision vector: 
1) BYOK: run a pilot (2 customers) in Q3 with escrow + attestation process;
2) Retention: default = tiered (90d hot + opt-in extended 24mo cold archive); extended full-warm only by special agreement;
3) SOC2 evidence export: include as opt-in beta (self-service export + support runbook).
Vote? :thumbsup:

Julian: +1 for BYOK pilot. Add acceptance criteria: perf SLO for audit search median < 300ms for hot queries, and restore from cold < 4h for beta tenants.

Priya: Agree. Also add a per-tenant cost cap for beta (so one tenant's data doesn't balloon infra cost). We'll add billing guardrails and alerts.

Sam: Engineering note: estimated scope for tiered retention + flags + restore job = 3 sprints (including testing and runbook). BYOK pilot (handshake, KMS attestation, contract) is parallel but needs legal + onboarding time.

Maya: Action items: @Priya model cost scenarios and publish by Friday; @Sam spike index compaction + flag by EOW; @LegalBot draft BYOK clause and customer checklist; I'll schedule a 30m stakeholder sync to decide beta customers. Any blockers?

Julian: No blockers from product side. One ask: add telemetry events for retention opt-in and restore operations so we can analyze customer behavior.

OpsBot: FYI: created runbook issue for retention-restore and labeled it "runbook/retention" (issue #1234).

Maya: Thanks all — scheduling Thu 10am. I'll post agenda (pilot candidate criteria, acceptance tests, billing guardrails, contract timeline).
